column1: # The agent identifies itself with a shared secret, set on the server with:
# Every call is POST with the header:
# The secret is the only thing that ties the agent to Vaylo. It must live in a
# secrets vault (or supabase secrets), never in a file, never in chat, and never
# in code the agent ships. It is deliberately NOT an sk- key: it is a shared
# secret long enough that an accidental leak is not a credential leak.
# All actions are deny-by-default: if it is not in ALLOWED_ACTIONS above, the
# call is refused with 400, so the agent cannot invent actions.
#   { ok: boolean, [data...] }   or   { error: string, code?: string }
# 1. See what a clip produced — read-only, no key
# → { ok: true, row: { id, movement_type, score, summary, created_at } }
# 2. See the top PBs the agent can reference when it writes a hook
# 3. See what plans the coach catalogue lists
# → { ok: true, plans: [{ id, title, weeks, price_cents, active }] }
# 4. Run a clip through video-form-analysis (the honest "video editing" step)
#    The agent uploads the clip; Vaylo's existing function runs it; we return the
#    report id so the agent can fetch the summary with action 1.
# 5. Ask a coach to change an existing plan (write-only queue)
"change_note": "Shorten week 2 by two sessions; keep the ramp"
# 6. Mark a delivered plan (server checks order + coach + buyer)
# 7. Buy a coaching plan from the agent's wallet (server quotes + charges)
# → { ok: true, order_id, net_cents, fee_cents, gross_cents }
# → { ok: true, bumped: false, note: "leaderboard writes are server-side" }
